title: Hybrid retrieval
text: Hybrid retrieval combines lexical term matching with semantic vector similarity to improve recall across exact names and paraphrased concepts.

title: Reranking
text: A reranker scores a small candidate set with richer query document interactions and can improve the ordering returned by first-stage retrieval.

title: Reciprocal rank fusion
text: Reciprocal rank fusion merges ranked lists by summing a reciprocal score based on each document rank and does not require calibrated retriever scores.

title: Grounded evaluation
text: Grounded answer evaluation checks whether each factual claim is supported by retrieved evidence and whether citations identify the supporting source.

title: Agent approval
text: A reliable agent asks for human approval before consequential or irreversible tool calls and applies least privilege to tool credentials.

title: Trace evaluation
text: Trace evaluation examines intermediate model decisions, tool calls, arguments, results, retries, and the final response rather than grading only final text.
